sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: Friday this tab went 1-1. Today: Covers and WagerTalk agree on the Monday night Under.

straight.reasoning: Covers and WagerTalk both take the Under. Minnesota has gone Under in 16 of its last 19 games and its offense has stalled (no touchdown at home against Miami, 266 yards against Detroit). Buffalo may be without three starting offensive linemen against a defense that blitzes a league-high 73% of the time. The total has dropped from 46.5 to 44.5 even though about 87% of the money is on the Over, which usually means big bettors are on the Under. Playable to 44.

sections.label: NBA
sections.slate: Monday NBA includes Wizards @ Pistons (4:00 PM PT) and Lakers @ Hawks (4:00). Luka Dončić is uncertain with a back injury. Only one NBA pick made it today.

straight.reasoning: Detroit is on the second night of a back-to-back after an emotional comeback loss to the Lakers, and it's without Jalen Duren. The Pistons are only 10-11-1 against the spread as home favorites of 6.5-12 points under Bickerstaff. VSiN's pick. Check whether Anthony Davis plays for Washington. Quarter unit.

sections.label: Football
sections.slate: Monday Night Football: Bills @ Vikings, 5:15 PM PT on ESPN. Bills -3 to -3.5, total 44.5. Buffalo's offensive line is banged up (Dawkins, Anderson and Brown all in doubt), and Kyler Murray is questionable for Minnesota, so Carson Wentz may start.

straight.reasoning: Two sources agree, Minnesota is 16-3 to the Under over its last 19 games, and the line has moved toward the Under. Playable to 44.

props.reasoning: He has 11 catches over his last two games, and Buffalo's wide receivers are banged up (Palmer doubtful, Moore limited, Shakir questionable). Covers projects 4.14 catches. Price is an estimate; quarter unit.
